Consumed by `crates/vokra-models/tests/sbv2_parity_atol_calibration.rs::atol_values_are_pinned_against_baseline_drift` to detect silent drift (>50% in either direction) of any `crates/vokra-models/src/sbv2/parity.rs::PER_TENSOR_ATOL` value against its pinned baseline. The updater `tools/parity/sbv2_atol_updater.py` proposes edits to this file plus the code side; owner reviews and commits both TOGETHER per the memory `feedback-honest-parity-atol` redundant-recording rule. See `docs/adr/sbv2-parity-atol.md` §5 for the empirical-measurement cycle this file participates in, and this crate's `sbv2_parity_atol_calibration.rs` test's rustdoc for the RED->GREEN->REFACTOR walkthrough.
